plan.notes: Source: Onondaga Community College Undergraduate Catalog 2023-2024 (archived), program page 'Program: Computer Science (A.S.)', fetched 2026-09-30 via browser fetch of http://catalog.sunyocc.edu/preview_program.php?catoid=7&poid=495&returnto=199 and transcribed manually into the collector schema. Degree name is the catalog's TRUE name: Computer Science (A.S.). CREDIT TOTAL HONESTY: the catalog prints 'Total Program Credits: 63-64' (a range); this plan uses 63, the catalog minimum, because the Semester-3 'Computer Science or Mathematics Elective' is listed as (3-4) and is modeled here at 3 credits. A student taking that elective at 4 credits reaches the catalog's 64-credit top end. Semesters use the catalog's own printed term totals (14 / 17 / 16-17 / 16). PREREQS: the program sequence page publishes NO prerequisite chains, so every prereq array is left empty rather than invented; sequence order is the catalog's own. PLACEMENT CAVEAT (catalog note 1, verbatim in spirit): students who do not place into MAT 161 should see their advisor; a MAT 114 placement means taking MAT 114 in Semester 1 (in place of the Semester-4 General Elective), MAT 143 in Semester 2 (in place of the Semester-2 CSC/MAT elective), then MAT 161 in Semester 3 and MAT 162 in Semester 4. This placement path is documented here, not in external_prereqs. ELECTIVE RULE (catalog note 2): CSC 110 cannot be used to fulfill a CSC elective. GRADUATION REQUIREMENT: a minimum grade of C is required in all required CSC courses to receive the A.S. degree. CAVEAT ON NEWER CATALOGS: 2024-2025 and 2025-2026 (current) catalogs exist but the CS program page could not be retrieved from those catalogs at collection time; this plan honestly reflects the 2023-2024 catalog as retrieved.
